rows.grounds: object to be grasped; compound of śūla and agra
instrument; sandhi fusion of varadena and eva marked by internal join
gerundive expressing required action on the trident-tip
uncertain form; possibly tryaja with following particle in sandhi
past passive participle describing the held state

items.question: How must the tip of the trident be grasped and held in this described form?
premises: The trident-tip is the object designated to be grasped.
The grasping is to be done by the boon-giving hand.
The trident-tip is described as held in that grasp.
items.inference: The tip of the trident is to be grasped by the boon-giving hand and held accordingly.
uncertainties: The analysis and meaning of tryajatho are uncertain in this context.
items.plain_english: The tip of the trident should indeed be grasped by the boon-giving hand and held.
